description: Source code for auto WAN management, including WAN mode detection, switching, and configuration handling in a network device.

classes.name: macaddr_t
classes.description: Structure representing a MAC address with 6-byte hardware address.

methods.name: CheckEthWanLinkStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the Ethernet WAN link.

methods.name: CosaDmlEthWanSetEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables Ethernet WAN interface.

methods.name: AutoWAN_main
methods.description: Main function to initialize and start the auto WAN management thread.

methods.name: SetCurrentWanMode
methods.description: Sets the current WAN mode and updates system configuration.

methods.name: SelectedWanMode
methods.description: Sets the selected WAN mode and updates system configuration.

methods.name: GetLastKnownWanMode
methods.description: Returns the last known WAN mode.

methods.name: SetLastKnownWanMode
methods.description: Sets the last known WAN mode and updates system configuration.

methods.name: WanMngrThread
methods.description: Thread function managing WAN mode switching logic.

methods.name: HandleAutoWanMode
methods.description: Handles auto WAN mode based on last known mode.

methods.name: ManageWanModes
methods.description: Attempts to lock onto a WAN mode, retries, and handles reconfiguration.

methods.name: CheckWanStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the WAN connection, including DOCSIS and Ethernet.

methods.name: CheckWanConnection
methods.description: Retries checking WAN connection status multiple times.

methods.name: TryAltWan
methods.description: Attempts to switch to an alternate WAN interface/mode.

methods.name: RevertTriedConfig
methods.description: Reverts configuration changes if WAN mode switching fails.

methods.name: AutoWan_BkupAndReboot
methods.description: Backs up configuration and reboots device after WAN mode change.
